title: VPC WarBRD Grip
checked: LED number checked on a real grip on a WarBRD-D base: the green LED at the top is grip LED 01 (commands 02-04 do nothing), November 2026. The drawing itself is made from a picture. A grip can sit on different bases; the bridge picks this drawing when the base's VPC profile says the grip is a VPC WarBRD Grip.
